title: Signed tensor shift models and intrinsic laws
statement: theorem podReindexingTensorSignedShiftModels {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g] [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D) (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D) (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T) : ∃ SY : PodTensorSignedShift l E Y, ∃ SX : PodTensorSignedShift l E X, SY.Generators l E ∧ SX.Generators l E ∧ SY.Model l E D.shiftSource ∧ SX.Model l E D.shiftTarget

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; construction of the two signed tensor shift models.

proof.text: Use the explicit finite signed tensor comparisons and their quotient and generator equations to construct both strict tower comparisons and prove preservation of good complexes by shifts. Extract the two signed Roos laws from hD. Apply derived signed-shift descent separately on Y and X with exactly D.shiftSource and D.shiftTarget. Assemble both PodTensorSignedShift records from the fixed strict data and the derived fields, use their proved generator equations, and pair the two Model equations. The reindexing tensor data and its laws are not needed for this intrinsic construction.
